blocks.text: For the Safdieh family, pediatric home nursing means Saulie can enjoy more of childhood while his mother has support in caring for his complex medical needs. At preschool, Saulie Safdieh gets to do what children his age do: play, learn, and spend time with his classmates. Supporting him are Cherryl Bordonado and Catherine Macarandang, two Filipino nurses from Towne Kids who alternate shifts to help manage his medical needs and support his participation in everyday childhood experiences.
